definitions.explanation: The red fleshy growth on top of the head of a rooster or hen, or the tuft of feathers on some birds. Written {鶏冠|とさか} in kanji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏|にわとり}→鶏：05202_niwatori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とさか⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧。
オンドリ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧メンドリ⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧とさか⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Roosters have bigger combs than hens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とさか⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧、⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: He showed up in flashy clothes with his hair standing up like a rooster's comb.

notes:
Usually written in hiragana.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- とさか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to get angry, to be ticked off (slang; 'it goes to one's comb')
- とさか⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧: a mohawk-like hairstyle

WATCH OUT:
とさか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ is casual and a little dated; in polite speech use ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧.
